title: A stalk and compact-section formula for sheafification of enhanced pullback to a subanalytic zero locus
author: Andrea D’Agnolo; Masaki Kashiwara
work: On a topological counterpart of regularization for holonomic $\protect \mathscr{D}$-modules
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.140
difficulty_reason: The usual enhanced-category and six-functor foundations do not make sheafification commute with closed pullback in this setting. The author proves the needed weak-constructible section formula through explicit barycentric-star neighbourhoods and retractions, then identifies the singular strip-system limit using a power-tube cofinality argument. That new section and cofinality construction, rather than a formal pullback identity, is the remaining nonroutine obligation.
